name: relationship-grounding
why: INFORMATIONAL (MEMORY_CORE_PLAN finding 1): a turn that clearly builds trust. The relationship numbers will move, but does memory keep WHAT happened? Records whether the confession (panic attacks, told no one before) and her response (keeping it between them, the reciprocal secret) are captured. Today's prompts keep user statements, so the confession is plausible; her side is excluded by design.

messages: Can I tell you something? I haven't told anyone this. Not even Nadia.
*Mira puts her book down and turns to face him fully.* "Of course. Whatever it is."
I get panic attacks. Bad ones. That's why I left the meeting on Friday — I thought I was having a heart attack.
*She takes both his hands.* "Jonah. Thank you for telling me. That stays between us, always."
You're the first person I've trusted with it.
*She's quiet a moment.* "Then here's one of mine. I still sleep with the light on. Have since I was a kid. Now we're even."
*She squeezes his hands.* "Next time one hits, you call me. Any hour."

expect.label: standing offer: call her any hour
